evidenceBoundary.dietRule: Vegetarian status is never inferred solely from a name, map category, company status or registered office.

evidenceBoundary.mixedMenuRule: Mixed-menu venues remain relevant for explicitly vegetarian foods and must preserve item-level scope.
evidenceBoundary.holdRule: Unresolved identities and held menus remain research leads; this file does not publish, approve a manifest, or mutate existing reviews.
